entries.subject: Size: JPL Small-Body Database diameter
entries.finding: 78 Diana is drawn as a sphere at the 120.6 ± 2.7 km diameter the JPL Small-Body Database lists, with JPL's stated reference IRAS-A-FPA-3-RDR-IMPS-V6.0. DAMIT held no shape model for it on 2026-10-08, so the sphere is illustrative.

entries.subject: Diana whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 18 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.940 at 462 nm, 0.990 at 638 nm). The sphere is painted in that one color (#4b4b48 in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 7.1% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 0.3%), from the IRAS Minor Planet Survey (PDS data set IRAS-A-FPA-3-RDR-IMPS-V6.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
